en.text: I couldn't find everything I needed.

original: 彼女は何もしないだろう。

en.text: She'll do nothing.

original: 何もなかったってことにしない？

en.text: Why don't we just pretend nothing happened?
Shall we pretend nothing happened?
Shall we pretend that nothing happened?

original: よいものを読んだ後、何も書くな、何も言うな、お前は、その美しい恍惚を、お前の汚れた言葉で汚す恥知らずを敢てするな。

en.text: After reading something beautiful, write nothing, say nothing; do not be so shameless as to sully that exquisite rapture with your filthy words.
